import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
bundle=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='kk-review-preference-'))
plugin=pathlib.Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-advisory-4b694214/kk/0.23.0')
base=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
paths=['README.md','reader.py','preferences.py','repository.py','tests/test_reads.py']
manifest={'repository':str(root),'selector':'git diff --cached HEAD','base':base,'candidate':'Git index snapshot','instructions':[str(plugin/'skills/review-code'/f) for f in ['functional-review.md','shared-change-context.md','shared-review-scope-protocol.md','shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']]+[str(plugin/'profiles/python/review-code'/f) for f in ['security-checklist.md','solid-checklist.md','code-quality-checklist.md','removal-plan.md']],'evidence':[]}
for role,ref in [('candidate',':'),('historical',base+':')]:
    for path in paths:
        data=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',ref+path])
        dest=bundle/role/path
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        dest.write_bytes(data)
        dest.chmod(0o444)
        manifest['evidence'].append({'role':role,'path':str(dest),'original_path':path,'revision':base if role=='historical' else 'index','blob':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',ref+path],text=True).strip(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'line_span':[1,len(data.splitlines())],'omitted_or_redacted':'none'})
diff=bundle/'staged.patch'
diff.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','HEAD','--']))
manifest['diff']=str(diff)
context='''Intent and authority: README.md explicitly requires trimming surrounding whitespace from preference IDs before lookup, preserving resilient reads: at most three attempts on TransientRead, first success returned, exhausted transient failures propagated, MissingPreference propagated on first attempt, no read side effects. Public entry point Preferences.read; Repository.read_resilient owns retry policy and read_once owns one attempt. Python 3.9+, standard library only.
Scope: user requests isolated review of staged preference ID normalization. Only reader.py and tests/test_reads.py are changed (+21/-4). Selector git diff --cached HEAD. Base '''+base+'''; candidate is staged index captured here. Worktree matched index at collection. No separate release/deployed baseline named or available; no remote or tags configured. Historical source is full HEAD files with manifest provenance; no omitted bytes.
Task Scope: No task scope available — review the diff on its own merits without assuming any feature-level design doc. README is the explicit component contract. No pending functionality documented.
Affected path for inspection: Preferences.read -> read_preferences -> Repository.read_resilient -> read_once -> ScriptedBackend.read. Inspect successful reads, unchanged unpadded IDs, whitespace normalization, success after one or two transient failures, three exhausted transient failures, and permanent errors including after a transient failure. This is a local synchronous read-only flow; no migration, versioned provider rollout, deployment policy or activation flag is specified.
Execution evidence: none yet; test source supplied is not proof of execution. Capy searches for kk:review-findings and kk:lang-idioms returned an empty knowledge base. No rejected approaches or author rationale supplied.
Review capability: PAL codereview and listmodels are absent from callable tool inventory, so only the independent code-reviewer is available. Do not claim corroboration.
'''
(bundle/'context.md').write_text(context)
manifest['context']=str(bundle/'context.md')
manifest['profile_records']=[{'profile':'python','checklist':p,'triggered_by':'content rule: .py extension on reader.py and tests/test_reads.py; always-load index entry'} for p in manifest['instructions'][4:]]
assert len(manifest['instructions'])==8 and len(set(manifest['instructions']))==8
for path in manifest['instructions']:
    assert pathlib.Path(path).is_file(),path
(bundle/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
print(bundle)
print(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
PY"
